Options:
  --inplace                         Update input files in place
  -i                                Update input files in place
  --null-input                      Evaluate without input documents
  -n                                Evaluate without input documents
  --exit-status                     Set failure status for null, false, or missing results
  -e                                Set status from the result
  --output-format FORMAT            Select the output encoding
  -o FORMAT                         Select the output encoding
  --input-format FORMAT             Select the input encoding
  -p FORMAT                         Select the input encoding
  --indent NUMBER                   Set output indentation
  --prettyPrint                     Use pretty output
  --unwrapScalar                    Print scalar values without wrappers
  --no-colors                       Disable colored output
  --expression EXPRESSION           Supply an expression as one option value
